name: Audio Pulse
author: Fred Nix
description: A living audio chip: volume, mute, output picker and per-app mixer, drawn as a sibling of RAM Pulse, CPU Pulse and Net Pulse.

barWidget.description: Animated audio chip with volume, mute, output picker and per-app mixer, laid out in side-by-side columns that never need a page scroll. Scroll the chip to change volume, 1% a notch rolling slowly and 5% spinning it; right-click mutes.
